categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules of land numbers, extents, ownership details (primarily "The State"), and property classifications. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, structural modifications, or other specialized categories.
